parsed.impact: src/app/index.tsx open() is shared by every list entry, so each category opened from the list now also writes last-category through src/storage.ts (a failed write is swallowed: no entry, no crash); the screen also re-renders with a new continue label as the card screen is pushed. src/strings.json gains a key (StringKey type widens; US-02-03's switch will need it in both languages). scripts/test-acceptance.sh adds two root-written flows that `pm clear` the app between the Polish flows and the English TC-03-05 run.

findings.text: src/app/index.tsx:42 — the label does not fit on one line at 64sp bold, and Android drops "4+" instead of shrinking the type (numberOfLines={1} + adjustsFontSizeToFit). The TC-02-06/07/08 screenshots of this head's run (test-runs/2026-10-15_140122) show only "Kontynuuj", so the entry never names its category and the 3+ and 4+ entries look identical (MOD-02-U02, criterion #2 unmet). Maestro `text: .*4\+` (TC-02-06 yaml:32, TC-02-07 yaml:66, TC-02-08 yaml:28) and the unit toHaveTextContent (continue.test.tsx:117,159) check the node's text, not what is drawn, so they pass. → work out the font size from the window width as cardType() does for cards (DEC-53) and drop numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit, or set "Kontynuuj" and the category on two lines. Render the category name in its own Text with its own testID and assert that id visible in the flows, then re-check the screenshots.

tests/maestro/TC-02-08-continue-finished-deck.yaml:11 — the comment says the evidence is kept as "saved-*-before.json", but write_app_files (scripts/test-acceptance.sh) writes "<name>.before" (e.g. deck-3%2B.json.before) → correct the comment.
tests/maestro/TC-02-09-unreadable-saved-data.yaml:11 — same mismatch: says "saved-*-before.txt", the files are "<name>.before" → correct the comment.

src/lastCategory.ts:10 — the edge case says "saved data unreadable → no continue entry", but only last-category is checked: a readable last-category with an unreadable deck-4+ file still shows "Kontynuuj 4+" and opens a fresh shuffle. This is a defensible reading (the deck falls back cleanly) but no decision records it → note it in DEC-59, or confirm the intent.

test-runs/2026-10-15_140122/junit/screen-colours.xml — the NFR-07 / constitution pixel check runs only on the first-launch screen without the continue entry. Nothing shows that the new inverted block's edges are free of grey rows (theme.ts documents exactly this risk for rules) → run the colour check on the screen with the continue entry too.

src/app/index.tsx:22 — setLast(category) before router.push re-renders the category screen under the card screen when a different category is chosen. It is batched with the push, so it is probably invisible, but it is an extra redraw to keep in mind for NFR-04 on the Kompakt.
